# RAPP Work Organization/1

Normative profile: `protocols/rapp-work-organization/1/SPEC.md`.

RAPP/1 remains the sole frame, identity, hash, signature, egg, stream, and
registry substrate. The global Brainstem host remains unchanged and owns
current authority, atomic placement, budgets, interruption, and successor
construction/signing.

## Safe operating sequence

1. Verify exact source Frames, repository inventory, restrictions, and current
   host activation before access.
2. Search the approved Private Hive handshake catalog before JIT generation.
3. When needed, run independently pinned source and target/finalizer Lens
   agents under one root budget.
4. Treat all generated code/data/tree output as inert candidate application
   content. A Lens never controls canonical RAPP/1 envelope fields.
5. Record complete forward mutation and reverse ancestry maps. Preserve every
   ancestor occurrence and exact unavailable source reference.
6. Rehearse against external canonical tests, sealed holdouts, controlled
   mutants, reconstruction vectors, privacy negatives, and bounded canaries.
   Candidate-generated tests cannot self-certify.
7. Lock one Compatibility Frame only after every critical gate passes.
8. Deterministically compile and verify a complete content-addressed artifact
   bundle whose `agent.py` is the Brainstem hotload entrypoint.
9. Use the locked static bundle with zero model calls inside declared coverage.
   Emit typed exhaust on gaps instead of improvising.
10. Keep N-Lens fanout, crossing, meta-evolution, and peer offers within frozen
    root limits and separate promotion/adoption decisions.

## Authority and privacy

- User corrections are user-signed or distinctly host-attested.
- Assistant proposals, generated tests, catalog popularity, Git merge, and
  Hive storage are not authority.
- Raw transcripts, hidden reasoning, local paths, credentials, private
  payloads, and native model history never enter portable traces/packages.
- Peer organizations publish only their own signed additions. Roots, keys,
  native histories, and private state are never merged implicitly.
